mapper.select: SELECT id, shipper_user_id AS shipperUserId, vehicle_id AS vehicleId, hub_id AS hubId, starts_at AS startsAt, ends_at AS endsAt, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM shipper_shift WHERE shipper_user_id = #{shipperUserId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND starts_at <= #{now} AND ends_at > #{now} ORDER BY starts_at DESC LIMIT 1
